0x000852.en: 「My skills right now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x0008C3.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x00094B.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000A3C.en: 「Time to fall back...! I'm pulling out.」

0x000A74.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!?」

0x000AAC.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000BB0.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000C04.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000D55.en: 「So this is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DC3.en: 「Nngh! Beaten to the punch, was I...」

0x000E4E.en: 「I'm beat. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E8C.en: 「Eek, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F7E.en: 「Ngh... So I become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001035.en: 「Owowow... I give, that was a miscalculation.」

0x0010BA.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x00116E.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x0011A3.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00128F.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I'm not there yet...!」

0x0012DD.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013C7.en: 「D-darn it! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001405.en: 「Well, well... so this is where it ends.」

0x001434.en: 「I can't do any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014BF.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001625.en: 「I'll eject...@　Ngh...! I can't even do it with style...」

0x0016E3.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001852.en: 「So I still have far to go...!」

0x001981.en: 「...You're the only ones who made it back?」

0x0019C8.en: 「On this side, yeah.@　The other unit scattered as they retreated.」

0x001A1E.en: (Orders from above or not,@　that surprise-attack op really was reckless...)

0x001A83.en: 「...Then we'll cover the rear.@　The rest of you, fall back.」

0x001AD6.en: 「Nah, once we've reloaded, I'm back to work.@　No way I'm calling it quits after the Steel Dragons chewed us up.」

0x001B72.en: 「Don't push yourself, Chien.@　Your machine's taken a real beating.」

0x001BE3.en: 「Chienne... so they sent you over here too?」

0x001C29.en: 「Yeah, after I earned a little pocket money.」

0x001C82.en: 「Just between us, I ran into@　a shady old man on the job. He asked me to@　go scope out the temple solo.」

0x001D2A.en: 「Hey now, moonlighting? So did you turn a profit?」

0x001D83.en: 「Eh... about broke even, in the end.@　More to the point, leave the rest to me.@　Dying in a place like this would be boring.」

0x001E22.en: 「Says the one who just wants to hog the profit.」

0x001E62.en: 「I'm worried about you, is all.@　Now go. All three of us have to make it back@　to the surface, or none of it means a thing.」

0x001F14.en: 「Now then... looks like our pursuers are here.」

0x001F3C.en: 「Heh... looks like they@　still don't have their numbers together.」

0x001F8F.en: 「That machine, it's that brat from before!」

0x001FC0.en: 「But the shape's a little different somehow...」

0x001FF4.en: 「I'm Chienne Argent.@　A <Boosted Child>, same as Chien.」

0x002092.en: 「I'm the oldest of the three,@　so I'm sort of the leader.」

0x002125.en: 「Bronzo 27... it's Seolla now, right?@　Aren't they with you?」

0x0021B2.en: 「Well, maybe those washouts@　just never got summoned in the first place.」

0x00220B.en: 「And if Arado and the others were here, what then?」

0x002267.en: 「Those three were@　your comrades, weren't they!?」

0x0022B7.en: 「Hah, comrades!? Don't be stupid. Us and them@　just happened to be in the same place!」

0x002328.en: 「Besides, only we deserve to carry@　the Boosted Children brand!@　Those washouts are cutting into our business!」

0x00240A.en: 「Seems she's a different story from Arado's group.」

0x00243B.en: 「If anything, she takes pride@　in being a Boosted Child...!?」

0x0024A9.en: 「Well, the <School> put us through@　plenty of hell...@　but we came out with the strength and skills to survive.」

0x00252F.en: 「So from here on, we live it up!@　Make a name, climb the ladder, rake it in!」

0x0025B8.en: 「So she ran wild in the opposite direction@　from Arado and the rest...!」

0x00260B.en: 「Attention, Shutedonias forces.@　I, Kirkus Zan Valfarbia,@　shall strike down you invaders.」

0x00269E.en: 「General Kirkus... I'm Major Godel Noland.@　When I was stationed in Langran before,@　I once had the chance to see you.」

0x002765.en: 「I too cannot fall back here, for my homeland's sake!@　I'll stake my life to stand against you!」

0x0027EB.en: 「I understand your resolve.@　But do not think you can bar my path.」

0x002847.en: 「To turn the coming battles in our favor...@　this is one fight I cannot afford to lose!」

0x0028B3.en: 「Unknown approaching, crossing in from nine o'clock! Just one!@　<IFF> signal received! It's a Federation ID code!」

0x00296D.en: 「Yo, Lieutenant Kyosuke.@　So you did warp into this world after all.」

0x0029E8.en: 「I've got the gist of the situation.@　I'll lend a hand!」

0x002A69.en: 「Ahaha... how many golden snappers is that gonna be...」

0x002AA3.en: 「Tch, now I get why Chien had trouble!@　I'll back off for today!」

0x002B20.en: 「W-we're finished...!@　All surviving units, break off from the combat zone at once!」

0x002BE4.en: 「The outcome here is decided. You have family...@　and acquaintances back in Langran, do you not?」

0x002C8C.en: 「Your life is in my keeping.@　Once this war is over, you'll work for me.」

0x002CF1.en: 「To bring order and peace not only to Langran and Shutedonias...@　but to all of <La Gias>.」

0x002D89.en: (...Kirkus Zan Valfarbia...@　He seems to be more than just a warmonger.)

0x002E0C.en: 「The Valsione, huh...@　I'll wreck that ridiculous machine of yours!」

0x002E90.en: 「Stronger than the Cybuster, or weaker...@　Either way, it pays better to take down@　a Machine God here in <La Gias>!」

0x002F8A.en: 「Just as cheeky a brat as that Chien!」

0x002FDA.en: 「Hah!@　Weren't you the same way, back in the day!?」

0x003030.en: 「A strong-willed woman, a big brawny man...@　The last one, is she a pretty girl too, maybe!?」

0x0030AA.en: 「Hah! Whether you'll ever meet the last one,@　who knows!」

0x0030FD.en: 「Bringing down a Steel Dragon ace@　would add some shine to my name!」

0x003165.en: 「Before that, I'll strip off your cheap plating.」

0x00319F.en: 「Haha, the prey jumped right in on its own!」

0x0031E2.en: 「Your own greed comes first, always, doesn't it...!」

0x00322B.en: 「Hah, Chien left me some top-grade prey!@　Take him down, and the pay's all mine!」

0x0032BA.en: 「I won't hand my head@　to the likes of you.」

0x00330D.en: 「General Kirkus!@　If I defeat you, this war ends!」

0x003366.en: 「It's not so simple.@　That's why I cannot afford to be struck down here.」

0x00341B.en: 「Yeah, you too, Lieutenant. Good to be back here.@　And... Masaki's probably in La Gias too, right?」

0x003506.en: 「We're all getting by like this, aren't we?@　It'll take more than a little to finish us off.」

0x00359C.en: 「Hey, Ryusei, lend me some cash, huh?@　An all-you-can-eat golden snapper tab is rough~」

0x003635.en: 「It's kinda your fault too, y'know~@　Come on~」

0x003698.en: 「Ensign Tasuku and Lieutenant Kyosuke@ had a bet going. Over whether Ensign Ryusei@ would come back to the surface or La Gias.」

0x003752.en: 「Making me the subject of your bets, real nice...」

0x003792.en: 「By the way, Ryusei. Earlier@　you said you had the gist of the situation.@　How come?」

0x003822.en: 「Yeah... after I warped to La Gias,@　the ART-1 started acting up.」

0x003899.en: 「That's when I met a guy named Demeksa Shie,@　and he put me up for a while.@　That's how I heard all kinds of things.」

0x0039AB.en: 「A Surface-dweller like me, and a Machine God pilot.」

0x0039E5.en: 「I'd heard he was a Surface-dweller, but@　he never mentioned the Machine God...」

0x003A7B.en: 「I could tell you, but he's not there anymore.@　When we parted, he took off somewhere.」

0x003B07.en: 「He said there was something he had to do@　at the request of Kirkus's army,@　but I didn't hear what it was about.」

0x003BA6.en: 「So he told you about us,@　and that's how you came here...」

0x003C11.en: 「Yeah. He warned me not to move carelessly@　until the fighting died down...@　but when I said I wanted to find my comrades, he told me.」

0x003CC5.en: 「This Demexae... did he have@　any information on the other@　Steel Dragon Squadron members besides us?」

0x003D46.en: 「No, nothing beyond what you told him...」

0x003DEF.en: 「I've cleared the area. What did you want to discuss?」

0x003E23.en: 「First... I hear Demexae Shiie@　is operating under your command.」

0x003E8B.en: 「Ah, I didn't mention it. I've had him@　tracking down the priests who@　were scattered in the chaos.」

0x003F15.en: 「So you can send the surface-dwellers home later?」

0x003F71.en: 「Then let's get to the point.@　I've heard from a certain source that@　Prince Feil-Lord is alive.」

0x004001.en: 「Why did you keep that from me, General?」

0x00404A.en: 「...No sense playing dumb now.@　Yes, the Prince is alive.@　And I hear he's fighting the Shutedonias army.」

0x0040F5.en: 「Then why don't you join up@　with Prince Feil?」

0x0041AA.en: 「These frequent surface-dweller summonings...@　I suspect the Prince engineered them.」

0x004258.en: 「First, only a handful of casters@　possess that kind of power.@　And the Prince is among them.」

0x0042E2.en: 「Second... I know his temperament well.@　It isn't public, but the Prince once@　failed his magic aptitude test...」

0x004399.en: 「After brutal, punishing training, he@　retook it and passed with flying colors.」

0x004417.en: 「That's when it began. The Prince@　developed a complex about power...」

0x00447C.en: 「Be it authority or force of arms.@　Prince Feil is forever chasing power.」

0x0044F3.en: 「In other words, to seize the surface's@ technology and military strength...@ could that be why he decided on this mass summoning?」

0x0045B1.en: 「Of course, I can't be certain.@　But if it's true, it's a grave matter.」

0x00460D.en: 「Summoning surface-dwellers and weapons@　en masse would only throw this world into chaos.」

0x00467B.en: 「True... In fact, this summoning felt@　less deliberate than accidental--@　that's how it seemed to me.」

0x00470B.en: 「The Prince stops at nothing for his goals--more than he needs to.@ That's why I'm uneasy... whether I should@ lend him my strength...」

0x0047DA.en: 「And... to be honest, I have ambitions of my own.@　In all this chaos, I want to test@　how far my own power can carry me.」

0x004885.en: 「...I see. I understand your doubts about the Prince.@　For now, I'll trust you.」

0x004902.en: 「But I am a pilot of the Masou Kishin.@　If you drown in your own ambition@　and throw the world into chaos...」

0x0049A4.en: 「I know. ...Well then, Yang Long, I'll@　return to headquarters. You wait here@　with the Hiryu Kai.」

0x004A37.en: 「Once I've worked out our next move,@　I'll send for you again.」
